official.deadline_note: Final (second, extended) deadline of the published 2026 call: the call's original closing date was 1 June 2026 and the official application form carried a second application window from 10 to 26 June 2026; the nominating diplomatic-consular mission had to submit its list of endorsed candidates to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs by 3 July 2026. This round is now closed and the Ministry states the competition is announced every year, so the next call is expected around early 2027.
official.application_cycle: 2026/2027 call: one year of intensive Serbian-language study in the 2026/2027 academic year, followed by enrolment at higher education institutions founded by the Republic of Serbia in the 2027/2028 academic year
official.status_note: The currently published call (Ministry of Education, Belgrade, February 2026) closed its applications on 26 June 2026 after the 10-26 June second deadline window, with lists of endorsed candidates due from Serbian diplomatic-consular missions by 3 July 2026. The Ministry publishes the competition every year, so a new call is expected around early 2027; no 2027 call had been published as of 10 October 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Free tuition within one level of studies, including undergraduate academic, integrated academic, and vocational studies, specialist vocational studies, master academic and vocational studies, specialist academic or doctoral studies.
benefits: Free preparatory Serbian language instruction (intensive Serbian language course upon arrival in the Republic of Serbia); not applicable to recipients who already studied in Serbia and attended Serbian language classes

Free tuition within one level of studies, including undergraduate academic, integrated academic, and vocational studies, specialist vocational studies, master academic and vocational studies, specialist academic or doctoral studies
A monthly scholarship in the amount of RSD 18,000.00
Free accommodation and meals at student standard institutions founded by the Republic of Serbia or the Autonomous Province of Vojvodina

Voluntary healthcare insurance for scholarship recipients studying the Serbian language; mandatory healthcare insurance for recipients under 26 years of age and voluntary healthcare insurance for recipients over 26, who are strongly advised to secure a policy independently
Free recognition of secondary school diplomas and free recognition of higher education diplomas
eligibility: Citizen of a member state or observer state of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM)
Proposed (nominated) by the competent authority of the participating state in the Project

Younger than 21 years old for enrolment in first-level studies (undergraduate academic, integrated academic, undergraduate vocational); younger than 25 years old for first-level specialist vocational studies and second-level studies (master's academic, master's vocational, specialist academic); younger than 35 years old for third-level doctoral academic studies

Completed four-year secondary education for undergraduate studies; for master's academic studies a relevant higher education diploma with at least 240 ECTS (60-ECTS programmes) or at least 180 ECTS (120-ECTS programmes); for doctoral academic studies completed undergraduate and master's academic studies, or integrated studies, with an overall average grade of at least 8.5
Knowledge of English at least at A1 level, or knowledge of Serbian at least at A1 level upon arrival
requirements: Pass the Serbian language examination with at least a minimum passing grade prior to commencing studies at a higher education institution founded by the Republic of Serbia
Pass the entrance exam at the chosen faculty and complete the enrolment process, arriving in Belgrade between 15 October and 15 November with original documents translated into Serbian or English

Attend all scheduled classes regularly and sit the prescribed examinations, earning a minimum of 37 ECTS credits during the academic year as required for budget-funded re-enrolment in the subsequent year
Regularise temporary residence status, monitor travel document validity and apply for renewal at least one year prior to expiry at the embassy or consular section of the country of citizenship
Inform the Ministry of Education of all changes of material relevance to scholarship status no later than 30 days after such changes occur
Return to the country that nominated them upon completion of their studies
documents: Curriculum Vitae with a motivational letter
Copy of the travel document (passport) - not translated; the travel document must be valid for at least another 6 years at the date of submission for a visa

Proof of acquired education: certified transcripts, secondary school certificates, diplomas of completed secondary or higher education, master's diplomas, grade transcripts and diploma supplements, translated into Serbian or English; for doctoral enrolment also the certificate of the average grade from the previous level of studies
Proof of proficiency in English or Serbian at a conversational level (certificate, attestation, confirmation, etc.)

Health documentation on the medical form issued with the call, signed and stamped by a physician of a recognised health institution in the candidate's country: vaccination record (tuberculosis, hepatitis B, poliomyelitis, diphtheria, tetanus, pertussis, measles, mumps, rubella, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Haemophilus influenzae); a medical certificate on general state of health, chronic conditions, current treatment regimen and a psychological/psychiatric assessment; and laboratory results for HIV, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, tuberculosis (QUANTIFERON-TB test or chest X-ray) and malaria, with all diagnoses in Latin and coded per ICD, and not older than six months on arrival
Completed and signed application form, submitted to the relevant institution in the candidate's country for formal endorsement
selection_criteria: Each participating state nominates candidates endorsed for a scholarship under the Project; all nominated candidates must meet the eligibility criteria
The Serbian diplomatic-consular mission may propose a candidate not on the list of the candidate's country's institution, based on its own assessment

A special inter-ministerial commission comprising representatives of the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Agency for Qualifications (ENIC/NARIC Centre) and the Student Health Care Institute of Belgrade reviews the documentation and conducts the selection

The decision on the final list of endorsed candidates is adopted by the Minister responsible for education (no later than 26 June in the published 2026 call) and is transmitted to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to notify embassies and all applicants

Health documentation is verified by the Student Health Care Institute of Belgrade upon arrival, which may conduct a general medical examination; the Ministry reserves the right to decline a candidate whose health documentation cannot be verified or whose health state is incompatible with residency in shared accommodation and the fulfilment of scholarship obligations
coverage: Free tuition within one level of studies at higher education institutions founded by the Republic of Serbia
Free accommodation and meals in the student standard (student centre) system in Belgrade, Novi Sad, Nis and Kragujevac
Health insurance: mandatory for recipients under 26, voluntary for recipients over 26 and for the language-learning year
Free intensive Serbian-language course and free recognition of secondary school and higher education diplomas
application_method: Step 1: apply via the official Google Form link published in the call (the form is titled 'APPLICATION FORM for Project World in Serbia - SECOND DEADLINE JUNE 10 TO JUNE 26, 2026')

Step 2: email the scanned original documentation plus Serbian or English certified translations to worldinserbia@prosveta.gov.rs, stating the candidate's name, surname and country of application in the subject line; documentation not translated into English or Serbian will not be considered

Step 3: submit the confirmation of the online application, CV with motivational letter, passport copy, certified education documentation, certificate of average grade, completed and signed application form and a copy of the health certificate to the competent institution in the candidate's country, in order to obtain formal endorsement

Step 4: the endorsing institution submits the list of endorsed candidates to the competent diplomatic-consular mission of the Republic of Serbia, which forwards it through the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to the Ministry of Education
official.application_route: Apply via the official Google Form, email the full certified documentation to worldinserbia@prosveta.gov.rs, then obtain endorsement from the nominating institution in the candidate's country, which passes the candidate list through the Serbian diplomatic-consular mission to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
official.citizenship_residency: Citizens of member states and observer states of the Non-Aligned Movement (NAM), nominated by the competent authority of their country; studies take place at higher education institutions founded by the Republic of Serbia - the University of Belgrade, the University of Novi Sad, the University of Kragujevac, the University of Nis, and academies and colleges of applied studies founded by the Republic of Serbia
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the scholarship is exclusively for foreign candidates from NAM member and observer states; study is in the Serbian language, with the possibility of consultations in English at the host institutions
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: No subject restriction - all study programmes and levels offered in Serbian at institutions founded by the Republic of Serbia are eligible; the candidate must be nominated by the competent authority of the participating state and may pursue only one study programme within a single cycle of studies
official.research_requirement: Doctoral scholarship recipients must additionally provide the Ministry of Education with confirmation that the topics for research papers and research seminars planned within the study programme have been approved, and confirmation that the doctoral dissertation topic has been submitted for registration or approved
official.duration: One year of intensive Serbian-language preparation (2026/2027 in the published call), followed by the enrolled degree cycle beginning in the 2027/2028 academic year
official.description: The 'World in Serbia' project is a Government of the Republic of Serbia scholarship initiative run by the Ministry of Education for candidates from member and observer states of the Non-Aligned Movement, offering free Serbian-language preparation, free tuition within one level of studies, free accommodation and meals in the student standard system, a monthly financial scholarship of RSD 18,000 and health insurance, implemented successfully since the 2010/2011 academic year.
official.english_requirement: Knowledge of English at least at A1 level, or knowledge of Serbian at least at A1 level upon arrival; all documentation must be translated into Serbian or English

applicant_utility.summary: Serbia's government funds tuition, dormitory accommodation and meals plus a RSD 18,000 monthly stipend for students from Non-Aligned Movement countries, but there is no direct route into it: you file the official Google Form, email certified documents to worldinserbia@prosveta.gov.rs, and then have the whole package endorsed by the nominating authority in your own country, which forwards your name through the Serbian embassy to Belgrade. Flights, city transport, textbooks, exam fees and the roughly RSD 4,300 of residence-administration fees stay on your own budget, and holders over 26 must arrange their own health insurance. The 2026/2027 round closed on 26 June 2026, and the Ministry re-announces the competition every year, so the practical move is to secure a nomination at home and watch the Ministry's site from around February 2027.
applicant_utility.best_fit: School leavers and recent graduates from NAM member and observer states in Africa, Asia, and Central and South America who can obtain a government nomination at home and are willing to study in Serbian after a preparatory language year.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm the nominating authority in your country (usually the education or foreign ministry) has re-opened nominations for the new round before preparing anything, since home-side endorsement is mandatory
Check passport validity now: it must remain valid for at least six more years from the visa submission date, so renew it first if it is close to expiry
Have certificates, transcripts and diploma supplements certified and translated into Serbian or English by an authorised person before the deadline - untranslated files are rejected outright

Build the health pack early: vaccination record, general medical certificate, psychological assessment and HIV, hepatitis B and C, tuberculosis and malaria tests, all signed and stamped by a physician with diagnoses in Latin and ICD codes, and under six months old on arrival

File the online Google Form and email the same scan set to worldinserbia@prosveta.gov.rs with your name and country in the subject line in the same week, then lodge the paper copy set with your national nominating institution before its internal endorsement deadline
common_rejection_risks: Applying directly to the Ministry or to a Serbian university without the nomination chain - files that never pass through a Serbian diplomatic-consular mission are never considered
Documents submitted untranslated, or translated by someone who is not an authorised certifier; the call states such documentation will not be considered
Missing the home-side endorsement window because the national nominating institution's internal deadline falls weeks before the Ministry's closing date

Health documentation that fails verification by the Student Health Care Institute of Belgrade (missing physician stamps, no ICD coding, stale results) or a health state considered incompatible with shared dormitory accommodation
Passport with less than six years' validity at the visa-application stage, or being past the age cut-off (under 21 / 25 / 35) at enrolment to the chosen study level
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Return airfare to and from Serbia, city public transport, textbooks and study materials, exam registration and other administrative charges at the university and student centre (e.g. meal card production), and the Ministry of Internal Affairs residence fees (RSD 420 application fee, RSD 2,120 temporary residence permit, RSD 1,788 biometric residence card); recipients over 26 also need their own health insurance policy.
document_audit: Passport validity of at least six further years from the visa submission date is the single most common silent disqualifier in this call
Translations must be certified by an authorised person into Serbian or English; keep those certified originals to hand to officials on arrival in Belgrade
Doctoral applicants additionally need the certificate of the previous level's average grade (at least 8.5 on the Ministry's published conditions)
Use the official medical form published with the call; test results older than six months are not accepted on arrival
The set lodged with your nominating institution is a copy set - original certificates and health documents must physically travel with you to Serbia
alerts: The round is annual with a spring call and roughly a 1 June closing (the 2026 call was extended to 26 June), so home-side nominations must be secured by April-May
Age cut-offs are applied at enrolment to the study level, not at the moment of application
One programme per cycle: after admission you cannot switch programmes, and finishing one level requires entering a fresh competition for the next
37 ECTS credits per academic year is a scholarship survival rule, not just an academic target - failure to earn them ends the funding
Scholarship holders are obliged to return to their nominating country upon completion of their studies
Questions go to svetusrbiji@prosveta.gov.rs / +381 11 3616-545; document submissions go to worldinserbia@prosveta.gov.rs
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Google Form first, email the certified document pack to worldinserbia@prosveta.gov.rs the same week, then have the paper copy set endorsed by your national nominating institution, which forwards the endorsed list via the Serbian diplomatic-consular mission to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; the inter-ministerial commission makes the final selection and the Ministry notifies embassies and applicants.
